Update suite owner and add hotrod-release suite Automated bug filing is no longer available but emails alerts are still active. These emails are sent to the 'owner' in the BUG_TEMPLATE dict. In this case we want these emails to go to chromeos-meetings@chromium.org (existing group that also receives CFM perf alerts). Also adding a hotrod-release suite which will run a smaller subset of tests on each new build in <=tot-1 branch builds. This is to be used for CrOS build sanity qual for both beta and stable builds. anx3429: add skeleton for FW update driver. this adds a skeletal "nop" firmware update driver for the anx3429 TCPC. the reef board file instantiates the driver, so it's actually invoked at boot time. it just tells vboot that the anx3429 firmware is up-to-date and no further interaction takes place. CHROMIUM: arm64: dts: rockchip: Add support for nefario-r0 Don't have boards yet so not booted, but in theory this is a good start. A few notes: * WiFi will probably be reworked compared to the schematics to make this more like scarlet. For now I'm not sure WiFi will work but this makes some attempt at hooking up regulators. * Just like on scarlet, the audio is not quite right because of the missing codec. We'll fix that once the audio driver changes land. Despite the above it probably makes sense to land this for now so we have something to start with.
